integrity: The all-rank mathematical proof is symbolic; finite exact rational checks and small-rank matrix enumerations provide reproducible corroboration but are not substituted for the proof. Direct and derived ingredients are attributed.
limitations: Only full Steinberg isotypic central projections on GL_n over finite fields; endpoint ell-1 and ell-infinity norms; fixed-q rank limit. Does not claim intermediate-exponent bounds, varying-q uniformity, or exhaustive historical novelty.
title: Exact Steinberg Fourier endpoint norms over finite general linear groups
